title: Comprehensive analysis of microbiota signature across 32 cancer types

evidence.quote: the microbiota profiles of samples from 10,362 cases (including 9,687 tumor tissues and 675 adjacent normal tissues across 32 cancer types)

method.status: inferred from reuse of TCGA-derived BIC profiles; sequencing provenance not detailed in this Markdown

evidence.quote: curated, decontaminated tissue-resident microbiota of 32 cancer types

needs_review: Map TCGA sample barcodes in supplementary S4/S7 to cancer types, then restrict positive genus abundances to eligible tumour sites.
Pooled pan-cancer differential tables cannot establish eligible-site genera.
notes: Main-text and supplementary Markdown reviewed; supplementary genera exported as candidates, not counted as eligible-site detections.

supplement_review.result: Genus abundance rows recovered, but columns have TCGA sample barcodes without a cancer-type annotation row. S1 gives aggregate cancer counts, not a sample-to-cancer mapping. Cannot assign positive abundances to eligible tumour types using these Markdown files alone.
